response.overview: *where_did_life_go* by Doctor Nowhere follows Jeppy, a peculiar, sun-headed character trapped in the repetitive cycle of everyday life. Each morning begins the same way, followed by another exhausting workday and the quiet anticipation of returning home. As the days blur together, the world around him gradually loses its color, and the little things that once brought him happiness begin to feel distant and meaningless. Seeking comfort, Jeppy retreats into a world of his own imagination, where reality feels less overwhelming and everything seems easier to control. Through surreal imagery, unsettling character designs, and a deeply melancholic atmosphere, the short film explores emotional exhaustion, loneliness, escapism, and the gradual loss of wonder. Beneath its eerie exterior lies an intimate reflection on what happens when simply getting through the day begins to replace actually living.
response.title: where_did_life_go
